notes: Tick interval is inlined as 10.milliseconds in execute_wait; the port exposes no WaitTick constant.

Wraps failures with upstream's prefixes ('failed to execute command:' / 'failed to save output:'), keeps the original error as the cause like Go's %w, reports a missing command function, and flushes the test output after each successful command while recording; all four behaviors are asserted.
Input.alt_sequence asserts ESC-prefixed named keys, single characters, and one Alt per character for longer keys. Divergence: browser key actions become escape sequences.
Stores the command's arguments in the clipboard; asserted. Divergence: the clipboard is process-local instead of the OS clipboard that upstream's atotto/clipboard writes to.

Input.ctrl_sequence asserts the C0 bytes for letters, the punctuation mappings, named keys, and that modifier-chain members are skipped. Divergence: upstream holds ControlLeft while pressing keys; the port writes the resulting control characters.
Sets the process environment (Crystal ENV instead of os.Setenv) exactly like upstream; the spec asserts the variable is visible after evaluating a tape with `Env`.

Pauses recording by clearing the flag (upstream PauseRecording); the spec asserts the toggle and the evaluator's Hide/Show tape spec covers the echo. Divergence: no mutex, because the flag is only read by the capture fiber.

Key names map to the sequences the terminal receives via Input.key_sequence (asserted for named, navigation, paging, and plain keys), and the repeat count now comes from the command's args with the per-key @duration or the global typing speed between repeats. Divergence: upstream types through the browser keyboard; the port writes sequences.

Trims the parser's trailing '%' and stores the percentage, matching upstream's strings.TrimRight + ParseFloat; the spec asserts `Set LoopOffset 60.4%` lands as 60.4. Before this, the untrimmed argument made every LoopOffset tape fail.
No-op behavior matches upstream ExecuteNoop.
Asserts the whole extension matrix in one tape: .gif/.mp4/.webm to the video outputs, a trailing-slash path to Frames ('.png' via the parser), and .test/.ascii/.txt to TestOptions.Output.
Writes the clipboard to the terminal and is a no-op when empty; asserted. Divergence: upstream pastes through the browser keyboard/textarea.
Looks the binary up in PATH (Process.find_executable vs exec.LookPath) and errors when missing; both outcomes are asserted.

Arms the next frame (ScreenshotNextFrame upstream) and rejects a missing path; the spec also asserts the capture loop records the frame and clears the arming. Fixing this exposed a struct-copy bug: the screenshots map update was written to a discarded copy, so screenshots were never recorded.

Asserts the radius reaches options.style and both renderer copies; the mask is covered by draw_spec.
Asserts false reaches options.cursor_blink?; the parser only lets booleans through, and the port also accepts on/off/yes/no for direct calls.
Asserts the family reaches options.font_family. Divergence: upstream also evals term.options.fontFamily in the browser, which the headless port has no equivalent for.
Asserts 18 reaches options.font_size and that 0 is rejected; upstream accepts any Atoi value, the port requires a positive size.
Asserts 25 reaches options.video.framerate and that 0 is rejected.
Asserts height 200 reaches options.style and both renderer copies.
Asserts 2.0 reaches options.letter_spacing and that 0 is rejected (upstream accepts any float).
Asserts 1.5 reaches options.line_height and that a negative value is rejected.

Asserts the fill color reaches options.style and both renderer copies.

Asserts Set Shell bash resolves to SHELLS["bash"] and that an unknown shell returns an error, matching upstream's map lookup.

Asserts /ready>/ reaches options.wait_pattern and that an invalid regexp returns an error.
Asserts 1m reaches options.wait_timeout through Vhs.parse_duration; this used to be parsed as milliseconds and rejected, so `Set WaitTimeout 1m` failed before.

Asserts the bar style reaches options.style and both renderer copies; the bar image itself is covered by draw_spec.
Asserts the bar size reaches options.style and both renderer copies.
Input.shift_sequence asserts the control keys (Enter/Tab backtab/Space/Backspace), every shifted punctuation mapping, and uppercase fallbacks. Divergence: browser key actions become escape sequences.
Resumes recording by setting the flag; asserted together with Hide.
Sleeps for the Vhs.parse_duration result and errors on an unparsable duration; the spec asserts a 60ms Sleep actually takes at least 55ms.

Writes the text character by character at the typing speed, now honouring the command's per-Type @duration (upstream parses it and errors on garbage) before falling back to the global typing speed. Divergence: upstream types through the browser keyboard and textarea for unmapped runes.

Writes a grayscale PNG where the rounded-rect coverage is the pixel value, which is what ffmpeg's alphamerge reads; corners are asserted 0 and the body 255.

Vhs.default_vhs_options sets the same 15 fields as upstream (fonts, sizes, typing speed, default shell, DEFAULT_THEME, cursor blink, 15s wait timeout, />$/ wait pattern); spec/vhs_spec.cr asserts each one and the style plumbing into video/screenshot.

Ported and wired into VHS#render: computes ceil(offset% * frames) % frames, advances StartingFrame, and renames the text and cursor frames for the offset range. Specs cover the no-frame error, the zero-offset no-op, a 50% offset moving frames 1-2 to 5-6, and modulo wraparound.

Modelled as the recording? property (upstream's flag behind a mutex); ExecuteHide flips it and the Hide/Show tape spec asserts the transition.

Asserts Start brings the instance up (started?, frames appear) and that stop marks it down. Divergence: the port starts a terminal emulator and frame capture rather than ttyd, the Rod browser, and a page.

Same 15 option fields (shell..style) with upstream types; defaults are asserted through default_vhs_options. Divergence: the bare struct default uses /^$/ for wait_pattern where Go's zero value is a nil regexp.
